CharacterRoster.title: Characters
CharacterRoster.draftHint: Give them a name first, then add images and a profile
CharacterRoster.searchPlaceholder: Search characters or series (name, tag, series)
CharacterRoster.workSummary: {characters, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} · {images, plural, one {# image} other {# images}}
CharacterRoster.mostUsedHint: By image count · card images + images made with them
CharacterRoster.loneHint: With one character there’s nothing to rank. Add a few more and this becomes a ranking by image count.
CharacterRoster.workFromTag: Leave empty to use the character tag: {work}
CharacterRoster.workNoTag: Leave empty to file under Original
CharacterRoster.imagesMore: {count, plural, one {# older image} other {# older images}} in your asset library
CharacterRoster.emptyHint: Create a character, or drop in a SillyTavern card (PNG / JSON).
CharacterRoster.behaviorHint: Write what they do, not adjectives: “holds the umbrella over others first” beats “kind”.
CharacterRoster.addImageHint: Images come from your asset library, from any folder. Upload new ones while picking.
CharacterRoster.importCardHint: Import a SillyTavern character card (PNG or JSON). You can also drop it here.
CharacterRoster.libraryAltGreetings: {count, plural, one {# more greeting} other {# more greetings}}
CharacterRoster.libraryNote: Public SillyTavern cards from chub.ai. Once made into a character it is your own card; its lorebook and system prompt are used when you chat with her.
CharacterRoster.libraryErrorHint: chub.ai isn't responding right now. Try again in a moment.
CharacterRoster.libraryNoResults: No cards match that. Try other words.
CharacterRoster.examplesHint: Start each block with '<START>', one line per turn: '{{user}}: … / {{char}}: …'
CharacterRoster.moodsHint: One per line, e.g. “Stubborn: denies it first, then softens.” Each chat turn picks one.
CharacterRoster.learnedPhrasesHint: Learned from how you talk in chats, one per line. Added automatically; delete any you like.
CharacterRoster.relationshipHint: She updates this herself when she looks back over your chats: what she calls you and how close you are. You can edit it.
CharacterRoster.draftExamples: Draft a few from the profile ›
CharacterRoster.alternateGreetingHint: Clear this one to delete it.
CharacterRoster.editorShortcut: ⌘/Ctrl + Enter to save · Esc to discard
CharacterRoster.summaryWhat: Notes from the card author for whoever uses the card. Not sent to the AI.
CharacterRoster.systemPromptWhat: The card author's main instruction to the AI, like "play this character well". Used only when you chat with her, never in the workbench.
CharacterRoster.postHistoryWhat: A reminder attached after the latest message every turn, like "reply in three paragraphs at most". Used only when you chat with her, never in the workbench.
CharacterRoster.lorebookWhat: Keyword entries: when a word comes up in chat, the matching lore is handed to the AI. In use.

phone.longPressHint: Long-press a card: edit · duplicate · delete
phone.libraryNote: Public cards from chub.ai. Open one to read it, then “Make character” if you like it.
